body:
Moved the pre-existing Compile hot-reload button from the right sidebar's bottom strip to the top bar, next to Save/Upload. Fixed the right sidebar's click behavior (previously an exact duplicate of the left tree, both new-window) to load a clicked file directly into the current buffer instead -- same in-place-load shape the Spotlight overlay already used. The right tree already browses the whole PARENA repo by default, so this makes examples/avr/blink.prn and examples/host_led/led_main.c directly openable/editable/re-compilable/re-uploadable from inside the editor. editor-demo builds clean (-Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror), Xvfb smoke test clean, make test: 347/347.

⚓ ☃
title: Editor affordances: Compile moved to top bar, right tree opens in-place (real Arduino dev environment)
